Package sysmlinjava.javaannotations.analysis.parametrics

package sysmlinjava.javaannotations.analysis.parametrics
Annotations used to declare field variables as an element of a SysML parametric analysis. SysMLinJava uses the annotations on fields to recognize and identify the elements that comprise the SysMLinJava model.
